note: Regional park on Redberry Lake ~10 km NE of Hafford, run by a local park authority. Mostly seasonal: about 64 of its 145 sites are sold by the night. A treed lakeside row looks out on the lake through a line of trees; sandy beach with a buoyed swim area, nine-hole sand-green golf course, stocked trout pond. --Claude
summary: Keep. SRPA page + Let's Camp (live, 27 bookable RV sites) + Google 4.3 (132). Non-accredited on the SRPA 2026 list but staffed/bookable. 15/30/50 A, no water/sewer on nightly sites; $21-42 + $10 day pass; season May 15-Sep 15. Mostly seasonal (~64 of 145 nightly, 44%). Waterfront lakefront -> lakeview. Pin OK.
flags: WATERFRONT: lakefront -> lakeview (stored value not --AWH; old evidence said 'no treeline screen'). The only lakeside row (Let's Camp map, east of Lakeview Lane, approx 52.7142,-107.2140 to 52.7149,-107.2133 on imagery) holds nightly sites 82-88 at its north end and 14 sites not sold online (seasonal). Photos of 85, 86, 87 and 88 face a continuous tree line with no water visible; Esri z17 shows a ~10-15 m band of trees/shrub between the RV row and a reedy margin, open water ~45-50 m out. The operator's own wording is a view ('so everyone has a clear view'). No named site sits over open ground at the water; the beach is day use. Row-to-imagery match is from the park map, not GIS points.

MOSTLY SEASONAL: SRPA counts 21 non-serviced + 20 15-amp + 20 30-amp + 3 50-amp nightly sites and 81 seasonal (145 total; the description says 148). ~44% nightly, so the note says 'Mostly seasonal: about 64 of its 145 sites are sold by the night'. Let's Camp sells only 27 RV sites + 20 tent/group sites online. Google 4.3 from 132 reviews (the panel covers the whole park, golf course included) - not iffy, keep.

NON-ACCREDITED: on the SRPA 2026 non-accredited list (p.47), which warns some such parks may have no staff. Presence is current: Let's Camp listing live with sites and photos, the SRPA page posts 2026 fees, season and booking-office hours, phone answers on Google. Keep.
NOTICE on the SRPA page: 'Our power will be shut off will be announced further into the season.' - garbled; reads as an end-of-season power shut-off date to be announced. Not added to fields.

HOOKUPS: electric 30 -> 50 (sites 69 and 70 are 50 A and sold nightly; SRPA lists 3 50-amp sites). Water/sewer left absent: Let's Camp marks water and sewer false on every nightly site, but SRPA's amenity checklist ticks 'Camping (Electricity, Water, Sewer)' (probably the seasonal sites) - unresolved.
SITES: count 148 kept (SRPA description; its breakdown sums to 145). max_rig_ft 50 added (Let's Camp maxRvLength; 15-amp row and 86-88 cap at 40).

FEES: added $21-42 CAD (non-electric to 50 A) and entrance {10,10,vehicle_day} from 'Park Entry: Daily Pass - $10.00' (the page does not say per vehicle; per vehicle assumed). Watercraft pass $10/day.
BOOKING: platform unset -> operator, url https://letscamp.ca/camps/redberry-lake; booking opens March 1.
FACILITIES added: showers (coin, $1), flush toilets (3 washrooms), vault toilets ('Washrooms (Outhouse)'), potable water, dump. SRPA lists 'Internet/Wifi' - not added (scope unclear).
OHV: 'NO DRONES OR ATV's ALLOWED IN PARK' - no OHV side.

PHONE 639-548-7900 and both website links confirmed.
